state.initial_message: Can you add an option to customize billing?

messages.content:
Thank you for your patience. I’ve confirmed your account (CUST_001) is active under the Standard SLA plan.

Since customizing billing options is a feature request rather than a standard billing error, I’ve created a ticket to have our product team review this for you. This ensures your feedback is properly logged and tracked.

**Ticket ID:** TICKET_89201

Our team will review the request and follow up if any changes are planned. In the meantime, if you have specific billing adjustments you need made immediately (such as changing payment methods or invoice details), please let me know, and I can assist with those directly.

We appreciate your feedback and are committed to improving your experience.
